title: Depth of the junta learner's output
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\delta\le 1/2$. If an outcome lies in the support of the learner's run on $f$ and its output is the decision tree $T$, then $T$ has depth at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
The outcome belongs to the support of the learner's run on the target
The outcome's output component equals the specified decision tree
